providers.plain_limits: Keep the transformed prediction first and the raw prediction second. Negative coefficients are intentional; do not clip or normalize them.
providers.validity_bounds: Revalidate Prepared. Require exactly normal/transformed dictionary keys. Convert predictions to float64 arrays of shape (100,), require finite entries and strictly positive transformed values. Rebuild visible history to obtain the step. Compute the existing normalized sigmoid schedule: 1.2 times the difference between logistic(-10*step/2000) and logistic(-10), divided by .5 minus logistic(-10). Return rows log(transformed)/log(1.02) then normal, and coefficients ratio then 1-ratio. The initial raw coefficient is negative. This adapter performs no weighted reduction. The interpolation is retained reconstruction policy; current source prose supports its endpoints but does not establish the exact formula.

providers.plain_limits: Supply complete checked replays and explicit controls. Both models train with one native thread. Private replays and fitted models stay private.
providers.validity_bounds: Require exact Prepared type, matching configuration fingerprint and canonical payload revalidation. Training, validation and query game identities must be disjoint. Generate ten float32 features before each observed round for each eligible player perspective, with separate seed-derived population RNG streams and independent one-in-five arm-row sampling. Reject sampled populations exceeding max_rows. Hidden initial thresholds become labels only. Fit two regression GBDTs sequentially: raw threshold and 1.02 raised to threshold. Preserve .05 learning rate, .9 feature fraction, .5 bagging fraction every five rounds, deterministic column-wise training and num_threads=1. Use caller seed, leaf count, iteration cap and stopping patience. Held-out RMSE drives early stopping independently for each model; require finite validation predictions and positive transformed predictions. Retain both boosters, best iteration, independently computed held-out RMSE, per-iteration metric history and sampled row counts. Decision seed and query observations do not enter fitting. These explicit reconstruction controls are not authenticated historical notebook parameters.
